s01076.summary: In an empty ballroom, Marguerite promotes Thaddeus to a hollow, budgetless title.
Thaddeus calls out the cuts and the callous funeral invite for his mentor.
Thaddeus unloads his guilt about smiling at trainees who are being laid off.
Thaddeus quits, slapping his name tag on the table despite Marguerite's warning.

s01020.summary: Okonkwo walks the derelict bowling lane evidence annex and asks who signed boxes out.
Okonkwo questions the anonymous tech, then the old alley owner Mrs. Kowalczyk.
Officer Tran reports the gate log's last entry was someone named Lennox.
Lennox the night man emerges from behind the boxes, there all along.
Bashir names himself and reports box nineteen's seal was cut with a razor.
Okonkwo stares down Lennox, asks for a walkthrough, and waits him out.

s01036.summary: Colonel Ashby-Grey arrives unannounced at Delphine's fitting with Yusuf behind him.
Agnes pushes back as the Colonel insists the wedding will happen Saturday.
As Yusuf measures, the Colonel demands a bodice so tight she cannot breathe.
Delphine questions Yusuf about distant Damascus, hinting at escape, alarming the Colonel.
Agnes secretly signals Delphine, then covers her slip about letting out the seam.
The Colonel studies everyone, sets the time, and leaves; Delphine steps down gravely.

s01035.summary: In a dark quarantined gift shop, Renata reports three calm souls to the bridge.
Adebayo and Miles joke about snow globes and placebo cures.
Adebayo coughs, and Miles learns it has been going since Tuesday.
Renata freezes everyone and blames Miles for claiming no one was symptomatic.
Searchlights from a strange hull sweep the promenade; it's not the dawn boat.
Renata radios the bridge; the captain whispers not to open the door.

s01060.summary: Under the lunar dome, Halcyon and Teodoro banter about the kale lunch.
Chioma reports a yield drop and Halcyon brushes the number off as a mood.
Halcyon draws out Teodoro's worry about pump seven and ignored maintenance tickets.
Nervous intern Nadeem joins their table on his second day.
The crew explain their jobs and tease Nadeem's textbook view of the bio-loop.
Nadeem says he likes pumps and Teodoro adopts him as his listener.
Commander Stone pauses to welcome Nadeem dryly, then moves on.
Nadeem tastes the kale, the crew eats as Earth turns overhead.

s01042.summary: Coach Pike rallies her losing team between periods while they quibble about the score.
Coach pushes injured Zeke to play, shutting down Dom's objections about his knee.
Mei-Ling vows nobody gets past her; the horn sounds and they rise together.

s00002.summary: In the flooded bee library, Tamsin finds a humming book while Bram skims comb.
Seraph Vane enters in a feathered coat, hears the hum, and asks for the keeper.
Tamsin quietly slides the humming book back and the bees fall silent.

s01065.summary: In a leaky courtroom, Pratt disputes Dexter's eviction notice over an unannounced rent increase.
Marisela calls out the dark hallway notice until the judge reins her in.
Pratt exposes the broken stove; Marisela mocks the hot plate replacement and the judge halts it.

s01077.summary: At a dead locomotive on the salt flats, Orozco spots dust on the road.
Voss calms the frozen lieutenant, then sees both armor and trucks coming.
Voss rejects hiding in the engine and pulls out a signal mirror.
Voss flashes the mirror toward the ridge; nothing answers, but she keeps signaling.
As the enemy nears, Voss stays Orozco's rifle and keeps signaling while he counts.

pd_earnest_4.summary: Cecily drops manners to confront Gwendolen, who answers with a snobbish barb.
Merriman arrives to lay tea, forcing the rivals into glaring restraint.
Gwendolen and Cecily trade sweetly veiled insults about country and town life.
Cecily spitefully loads Gwendolen's tea with sugar and serves her cake.
Gwendolen rises in indignation and warns Cecily; they declare open enmity.
Jack enters and Gwendolen hails him as her own Ernest.

s01021.summary: Ignacio oils the turning lighthouse lens, humming off-key and content.
The hatch bangs and Ignacio freezes, listening to boots climbing the stairs.
Soaked Wren hauls herself up, having rowed nine miles to reach him.
Ignacio confronts Wren about the four-line letter ending things.
Ignacio turns away; Wren notes he kept the light on and polished.
Wren admits she nearly drowned; Ignacio imagines himself oblivious up here.
Pressed to speak, they both say they missed each other, still angry and scared.
They banter over dripping floors, a towel, and suspicious months-old tea.
Ignacio invites her down, carries her suitcase, and they descend together.

s01048.summary: Dee-Dee hosts the four a.m. show from a cornfield radio studio.
Roland reports the transmitter running hot; Dee-Dee tells him to let it be.
Sleepy Cal brings CDs and mentions one nameless repeat caller.
The caller requests Wild Horses and dedicates it to the three of them.
Asked his name, the caller says they can see him; a flashlight shines from the field.
Dee-Dee keeps her voice steady and plays the song; the light goes out.

s01067.summary: Abigail counts ice blocks for the garden party while Tobias whittles.
A stranger seeks the master; Abigail questions who he is.
Told the Ashworths left, the stranger admits he came for a sealed tin.
He reveals he is Rupert Ashworth, supposedly dead in the Punjab.
Tobias moves to shield Abigail as Rupert insists he only wants the tin.

s01115.summary: In the treehouse, Augustine and Kieran tease Winnie about cheating at cards.
Winnie throws a card; shy newcomer Lotte offers licorice and everyone takes some.
Lotte introduces herself and says she moved from faraway Rotterdam.
The four settle into green quiet; a card lands in Lotte's lap and she grins.

s01032.summary: At a sugar mill, Henrik sets Jethro and Pilar's grips for arm wrestling.
Locked in stalemate, Pilar needles Jethro about his sweat and apron.
Jethro surges an inch forward but Pilar drives back to even.
Frozen in deadlock, they connect over her father and Matanzas.
Jethro lunges, the table collapses, and they tumble wrestling across sacks and barrels.
They agree to a truce and Henrik declares the match a draw.
Joking about her dead father, Pilar smiles and slams her elbow down for a rematch.

s01089.summary: In a church field hospital, Siobhan has Teddy search the radio bands.
News of enemy withdrawal stirs the room; Siobhan cautions and checks Oswin.
Rosalind checks Mikhail's wound and they joke quietly about his wife.
The radio announces a six a.m. ceasefire; Rosalind collapses onto the cot.
Siobhan carefully folds the bloody altar sheet as the candle holds.
Siobhan orders everyone to rest and takes first watch by the candle.

s00004.summary: On a riverboat deposition, genial Neely charms while Miles guards him stiffly.
Horace asks pleasant routine questions about the boat over Miles's objections.
Horace turns to the engine room fire and the door locked from outside.
Horace reveals the dead contractor's widow delivered the incriminating work order.
Shaken Neely begs Miles to act; Miles fumbles for a recess.
Neely admits the engine room was supposed to be empty for the insurance fire.
Horace finally uncaps his pen, writes one line, and ends the session.

s01066.summary: At an ice floe camp, Bernadette radios Rescue One through static.
Bernadette announces rescue in two hours and Darius rallies.
The floe splits; they leap into the raft and cut free as the stove sinks.
Rescue One comes through clear, saying they have them located.

s01101.summary: In a dim hangar, Luciana orders Dorian to wake the dead console.
Imani interrupts to report the hull is making a noise.
Rhythmic tapping rolls through the metal; Esperanza reads it as a countdown.
Station Operations radios that they're locked in and have been tapping.
Comms insists the crew isn't in bay four; the tapping isn't theirs.
The light dies and something laughs from the vent; Teo drops his datapad.

s01057.summary: On the hospital barge, Ismail runs night rounds as the hull groans.
Bored Mrs. Wray chats with Ismail; Linh reads her the cracker box.
Tobias moves on, the horn sounds, and Linh jokes about shore leave paperwork.
Bronwen tucks in Mrs. Wray and reassures her everything is fine.

s01043.summary: Cornelia strides into the assay office before closing and drops her pouch.
Thaddeus examines and acid-tests her Dry Creek gold and finds it good.
They haggle the price per ounce up to seventeen and the sack.
He pays; she brushes off his concern about a woman alone.
At the door Cornelia exposes his rigged scale; he orders her out.
Hand under her coat, Cornelia demands the strongbox and its hidden four thousand.
Thaddeus surrenders the hidden bundles and they agree they never met.
Cornelia leaves as the doorbell jingles long after.

s01078.summary: Danny enters the empty 1989 rink and decides to wait near June.
They chat shyly, share free popcorn, and mock Mr. Pruitt over the PA.
Danny shows a missing-person flyer for his sister Rosalind, who worked here.
June tells him of Pruitt's locked room with Rosalind's jacket on the door.
Pruitt opens the rink early; June slips Danny the keys for four o'clock.
Danny pockets the keys and vanishes into the crowd as June resumes work.
